name: Address
description: Say a file's name, get its address typed where you are writing: "mention mission" types @docs/MISSION.md into Claude Code.
author: BranchKit

reasons.privilege:input: To type a file's address where the cursor is.
reasons.privilege:locale: To show when Claude Code last reported your project in your own time zone and format.

hud_cards.description: The file list and the files a name could mean, each beside a word to say

address_files.label: Files you can mention

fields.label: Folder the paths are relative to

address_files.description: The spoken names of the files in the project you are working in, each with the file or files it could mean. Published from the Claude Code hook each time you send a prompt, so it follows the project of your latest prompt. A name with more than one file asks which when you say it.

plugin.address.choices.description: The files on the open list, each beside the word that picks it: the list "mention" opens, or the files an ambiguous name could mean. Cleared when the list closes.

plugin.address.choosing.description: Choosing which file an ambiguous name meant. Exclusive, so only the badge words and "cancel" are heard until you pick or the hold ends.

plugin.address.browsing.description: The list "mention" opens is on screen. Adds its badge words and "cancel" to what you can say, in every hold until you pick a file or close the list; everything else still works.

plugin.address.lately.label: Files lately
plugin.address.lately.description: Per project, the files the working tree last changed and the files you mentioned most recently: what "mention" lists. Kept so the list is there after a restart, before the next prompt reports the project. Delete a record to forget the files you mentioned in that project.

plugin.address.learned.label: Names you have taught
plugin.address.learned.description: Your answers to "which file?": once you pick a file for a name that could mean several, saying that name in that project types it directly. Delete a record here to be asked again.
